# Changelog — hisd-brand-designer

All notable changes to this skill. Format: [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com);
versioning: [SemVer](https://semver.org). The authoritative version lives in
`versioning/version.manifest.json`; `SKILL.md` frontmatter mirrors it.

## [Unreleased]

### Changed
- **Ribbon line kit: deterministic edge-to-edge stroke generator + 10 named presets**
  (replaces the fixed 4 variants). The Ribbon's white "bayou current" strokes are now
  produced by `framework/ribbon-gl/ribbon-lines.js` (`ribbonLine` between two edges,
  `generate(seed)`, `preset(name)`, `linesToSVG`); a composition is a named preset
  (`currents`, `delta`, `bayou`, `crossing`, `calm`, `weave`, `bend`, `loops`, `drift`,
  `channels`) or any integer seed (deterministic — same seed → same strokes). Strokes are
  thicker/wider (edge-to-edge); the WebGL rung is crisper (reduced flow warp) so they stay
  sharp; new `variant`/`seed` props on `<Ribbon>` / `<hisd-ribbon>` / `createRibbon`. The
  committed `assets/ribbon/ribbon-field-*.svg` are generated by `scripts/gen_ribbon_fields.mjs`.
  No new tokens (colored through `--ribbon-stroke` / `-opacity` / `-field-bg`).
  `Components.md`, `Iconography-And-Imagery.md`, and `Token-Reference.md` updated.
- **Ribbon realigned to the canonical field-of-white-strokes device** (replaces the
  gradient-band model). The Ribbon is a solid brand-color field overlaid with a few soft,
  white, round-capped, low-opacity sweeping/looping strokes that drift across it like bayou
  currents, used full-bleed as a background; new `--ribbon-stroke` / `--ribbon-stroke-opacity`
  (0.16 light / 0.22 dark) / `--ribbon-field-bg` (teal-500, overridable per section) tokens;
  CSS + WebGL retargeted (drift = the white strokes flowing, never a band sliding; the WebGL
  rung composites a flow-warped white-stroke texture over the solid field via
  `createRibbon(canvas, {field, intensity})` with `uField`/`uStroke`/`uStrokeOpacity`
  uniforms). Canonical assets are `ribbon-field.svg` (default) + one `ribbon-field-<preset>.svg`
  per line-kit preset; the old
  `--ribbon-gradient`/`-fan` tokens and `ribbon.svg`/`ribbon-band.svg` are retained as
  constrained-media accents only. `Components.md` (Ribbon + Animated Ribbon),
  `Token-Reference.md`, `Iconography-And-Imagery.md`, and `assets/ribbon/README.md` updated.

### Added
- Theme Toggle `appbar` variant for Rayfin/HISD app bars. Its active dark-mode
  option uses a light gray pill with an icon color supplied by the app bar token,
  while inactive dark options remain subtle.
- **OKLCH theming foundation.** `build_tokens.py` now emits an `@supports`-gated
  enhancement layer: each semantic color is re-declared as `light-dark(oklch(…),
  oklch(…))` (computed from the hex, so identical on sRGB — all 150 tokens
  round-trip OKLCH→hex with 0/255 drift), and `color-scheme` is wired to
  `[data-theme]` so `light-dark()` honors the manual override and native controls
  theme correctly. The sRGB **hex stays the primary value** (fallback + the
  print/email/Power BI export); contrast gate byte-identical. Strategy documented
  in `Docs/Design-System/Theming.md`.
- **Accessibility system tokens** — `--focus-ring-width` / `--focus-ring-offset`
  (one focus geometry for the whole library; reconciles the doc's 3 px to the
  2 px components actually ship), `--target-size-min` (24 px) / `--target-size-touch`
  (44 px), and `--scroll-margin-sticky` (focus-not-obscured clearance).
- **`prefers-contrast: more`** hardening block for Safari/iOS Increase-Contrast
  (where `forced-colors` never fires): promotes borders to strong, gives muted
  text full contrast, widens the focus ring to 3 px.
- **`scripts/audit_focus_contrast.py`** — measured WCAG 1.4.11 focus-ring
  contrast gate over every surface in both themes, wired into CI. Proves
  `--color-focus` clears 3 : 1 on all primary surfaces and flags the brand/
  action/inverse surfaces (1.0–2.9 : 1) that require the two-tone focus ring.

### Changed
- Migrated every component's focus-ring width to `var(--focus-ring-width)` so the
  `prefers-contrast` widening reaches all rings.
- `Accessibility.md` reconciled: corrected the 2.4.11-vs-2.4.13 SC mislabel;
  codified "status is never carried by color or motion alone — icon + text +
  bilingual + `aria-live`"; tiered reduced-motion; target-size tokens + the 2.5.7
  dragging-movements gate; documented the two-tone focus recipe and the
  forced-colors / `prefers-contrast` pairing.

## 1.3.0 - 2026-06-25

### Added
- **Animated Ribbon — CSS tier (rungs 0–1).** The Ribbon device now ships a coded,
  in-DOM component (`components/ribbon.css` + `ribbon.html`) on a three-rung
  progressive ladder: **static SVG → CSS-animated → WebGL** (WebGL noted for a later
  phase). The fixed class contract — host `.hisd-ribbon` (`role="presentation"`),
  the band wrapped in a `<g class="hisd-ribbon__band">` so CSS transforms the group,
  the `.hisd-ribbon--animate` and `.hisd-ribbon--fan` variants, and a `--hisd-ribbon-h`
  sizing prop — is the markup the Phase-3 React / Web Component adapters will reuse
  verbatim. Motion is compositor-only: `@keyframes hisd-ribbon-flow` drifts the band
  ±2 % via `transform: translateX` on `--duration-slower` / `--ease-emphasized`,
  `infinite alternate`, with an optional `stroke-dashoffset` highlight shimmer; no
  layout or paint property is ever animated, and bounded overflow keeps ≥ 20 % of the
  arc visible. All color flows through `--ribbon-*` tokens (no raw hex).
- **Animated-Ribbon motion guards.** Both `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`
  and `@media (forced-colors: active)` set `animation: none !important` on the band +
  highlight (token-zeroing alone does not stop a `@keyframes` loop), so the component
  degrades cleanly to the static SVG floor. The canonical `ribbon.svg` is unchanged and
  remains the static floor + mask source for the later WebGL tier.

### Changed
- `Docs/Design-System/Components.md` gains an **Animated Ribbon** subsection under the
  Ribbon entry (the three-rung ladder, the class contract, the decorative + motion a11y
  contract, and a copy-paste example); `assets/ribbon/README.md` gains an **Animation**
  section pointing at the CSS tier.

## 1.2.0 - 2026-06-21

### Added
- **Tiered reduced-motion model.** New `--duration-crossfade` (200 ms → 120 ms
  under reduce) and a `--motion-reduce` flag. Movement now reads the speed ladder
  (zeroed under reduce) while opacity crossfades read `--duration-crossfade`
  (retained), so the skeleton-to-content "data arrived" cue is no longer deleted
  by reduced motion. Emitted by `build_tokens.py`.
- **Skeleton component** (`components/skeleton.css` + demo): loading bones with a
  sheen paused under `prefers-reduced-motion` AND `forced-colors`, the
  `.hisd-skeleton-reveal` opacity crossfade, a bilingual `aria-live` loading
  pattern, and `.hisd-media-frame` — a CLS-proof image box (aspect-ratio +
  dominant-color placeholder + fade-in, lazy by default, eager for the LCP hero).
- Added the coded Theme Toggle component, including token-only CSS, demo markup,
  and a typed React wrapper for icon-based light/dark app controls.
- Added Rayfin App Styling guidance for HISD Fabric/Rayfin app bars, dark-mode
  app bars, primary buttons, filled filter chips, and browser-proof surfaces.

### Changed
- **Motion model corrected.** `Docs/Design-System/Motion.md` replaces the blanket
  `prefers-reduced-motion` duration-zeroing with the tiered model above;
  `Components.md`, `Patterns.md`, and `Iconography-And-Imagery.md` updated for the
  Skeleton primitive and the responsive-image loading recipe.
- Renamed the skill `hisd-branding` → `hisd-brand-designer` (canonical
  directory, `name`/manifests, and all four lane adapters regenerated). Same
  v1.1.0 content — no token, component, or API change. The old `hisd-branding`
  install is replaced by the renamed skill.
- Moved the canonical body into the `design` family: `.skills/hisd-brand-designer/` →
  `.skills/design/hisd-brand-designer/` (matches `family: design` in `version.manifest.json`
  and the layout already used by every Wonder-Forge consumer). Internal docs, asset
  manifests, and lane-adapter pointers updated; drift `--check` green.

## 1.1.0 - 2026-06-21

### Distributed
- **Wonder-Forge/Fabric-Workbench** → [#1](https://github.com/Wonder-Forge/Fabric-Workbench/pull/1) (vendor branch, family-grouped at `.skills/design/hisd-branding/`)
- **Wonder-Forge/Spot** → [#1](https://github.com/Wonder-Forge/Spot/pull/1) (family-grouped at `.skills/design/hisd-branding/`)
- **Wonder-Forge/Dataverse-Workbench** → [#1](https://github.com/Wonder-Forge/Dataverse-Workbench/pull/1) (family-grouped at `.skills/design/hisd-branding/`)
- **Wonder-Forge/SchoolNavigator** → [#9](https://github.com/Wonder-Forge/SchoolNavigator/pull/9) (flat at `.skills/hisd-branding/`)

Each target landed the canonical body (LFS-managed) + the 4 lane adapter sets, verified in-place (drift, contrast, lint, DTCG, brand scan all green).


### Added
- **Lamplighter skill modeling** — `skill.manifest.json` (authoritative contract:
  type `tool-bearing`, `exportable`, `repo-mutating`, the script map, validation +
  versioning references, declared adapters) and this `versioning/` layer.
- **Vendor-lane thin adapters (all four lanes)** — `scripts/project_adapters.py`
  projects the canonical skill into GENERATED THIN POINTER adapters at the model's
  exact surfaces: Claude Code (`.claude/skills/hisd-branding/SKILL.md`), Codex
  (`.agents/skills/hisd-branding/SKILL.md` + `agents/openai.yaml`), GitHub Copilot
  (`.github/agents/hisd-branding.agent.md`), and Gemini
  (`.gemini/extensions/hisd-branding/` with `GEMINI.md` + `gemini-extension.json`).
  Each pointer references the canonical body and never copies it (~1.5 KB stubs);
  `--check` is a drift gate, wired into CI. The README documents the
  install-into-another-repo workflow (copy `.skills/hisd-branding/` into the target
  repo, then run `project_adapters.py --apply` there). The assistant zip lanes
  (Claude.ai/OpenAI dev-API) are not targeted — at 155 MB / 1,310 files the skill
  exceeds their 50 MB / 500-file budget, which binds a full-copy zip, not a thin
  adapter.
- **Framework component library** — all 22 components wrapped as typed React
  (`framework/react/`) and framework-agnostic Web Components (`framework/web-components/`).
- **Expanded palette** — 4%/10% tint/tone/shade matrix for every brand color
  (`build_palette_matrix.py`, `palette-reference.md`), names on the main colors.
- **Material Symbols icon set** (73 filled, `currentColor`) replacing the hand-drawn set.
- **Dark-mode platform variants** (Power BI theme + backgrounds, social, email).
- **State-ladder tokens** (`--color-surface-hover/-active`, `--color-action-active`)
  and **forced-colors** (`@media (forced-colors: active)`) across all components.
- **Cross-platform rasterization** (`scripts/_raster.py`) — the app-icon and
  social-card generators now run on **Windows** (via Microsoft Edge), **macOS**, and
  **Linux**, preferring exact-dimension renderers and a headless-browser fallback.

### Changed
- **Color system** — the brand "Sunrise" yellow is now reserved to the four
  guide-approved combinations (never a general UI / warning / selection color);
  selection is a soft teal highlight; warning is an amber harmonizer. Pure white /
  whitesmoke only (the off-white is deprecated). Full positive/negative/warning/
  informational/neutral/action token set with `-strong`/`-surface`/`-border`/`on-`
  variants, AA-gated in both themes.
- Logo SVGs stripped of ~31 MB of non-rendered Adobe PGF metadata (geometry byte-identical).

### Fixed
- Declared the Python 3 requirement (`compatibility: requires python3 (>=3.8 stdlib)`).
- Made `brand_scan.py` self-exclusions skill-root-relative (portable to any vendor location).

### Workflow
- Documented the **evolve-and-reintegrate** model: the canonical body in each host repo IS meant to evolve; the drift gate only requires the lane adapters to track that repo's own canonical (it does NOT lock you to any external upstream). Improvements flow back to Wonder-Forge/HISD_Design as PRs.

- Initial HISD "Connected Futures" branding skill: the token build (`build_tokens.py`
